description: Whether Excel reads a conditional format, data validation or table column formula without its function prefixes. A workbook authored through this library carries an expression format over A1:A3 calling XLOOKUP (true for A1 only, bold), a colour scale over E1:E3 anchored at MINIFS and MAXIFS (red to blue), custom validations calling XLOOKUP on D1 and, reaching S2 through the x14 extension, on D3 (both hold 2, which XLOOKUP finds), and a table T whose column b is calculated from XLOOKUP and LET. The control is the same package with _xlfn. and _xlpm. removed from the rules, the validations and the table part, and nowhere else. Each was opened over COM, recalculated, and a row added to the table.
probe: a one-off COM script: Workbooks.Open, Application.CalculateFull, Range.DisplayFormat, Validation.Value, ListRows.Add then the new cell's Formula2
openClass: headless COM (DisplayAlerts off), opened for editing and closed unsaved
note: Range.Formula1 reports the same text for both packages (=XLOOKUP(A1,$B$1:$B$3,$B$1:$B$3)=1), so the formula text Excel shows cannot tell the two apart; only evaluating the rule can.
